sloka: शुभाम् रुचिर दन्त ओष्ठीम् पूर्ण चन्द्र निभ आननाम् ।आसीनाम् पर्णशालायाम् बाष्प शोक अभिपीडिताम् ॥३-४६-१२॥
transliteration: śubhām rucira danta oṣṭhīm pūrṇa candra nibha ānanām ।āsīnām parṇaśālāyām bāṣpa śoka abhipīḍitām ॥3-46-12॥

translations.english: The wicked demon came close to that auspicious princess from Videha sitting in the cottage Her face was like the full moon. Her teeth and lips were lovely. She was clad in yellow silk. Her eyes were like lotus petals tormented by tears of grief.
